lore.guildmark.0.title: Lore: The First Charter
lore.guildmark.0.page0: Before the walls and before the roads, every village stood alone. Then seven elders met at a cold bell and signed the First Charter, and the Old Guild was born.
lore.guildmark.0.page1: The Charter asked only this: that any villager in need could pin a note, and any stranger with a blade could answer it. The boards you see today are its children.
lore.guildmark.1.title: Lore: Wardens of the Road
lore.guildmark.1.page0: The Old Guild's best were called Wardens. They walked the roads between villages and kept them clear of beasts, and no caravan went unguarded.
lore.guildmark.1.page1: A Warden wore no crown and took no village as their own. 'The road is the only home we keep,' says the oath. Few remember the rest of it.
lore.guildmark.2.title: Lore: The Hollow King
lore.guildmark.2.page0: One Warden feared death more than any beast. He carved out his own heart and set a crown where it had been, and he did not die. They call him the Hollow King.
lore.guildmark.2.page1: Without a heart he could not be wounded, and without a heart he could not love the villages he swore to guard. He turned the beasts of the wild into his court.
lore.guildmark.3.title: Lore: The Court of Beasts
lore.guildmark.3.page0: The Broodmother, the Barrow Lord, the Drowned Herald, the Hollow Crone, the Frost Regent and the Ash Warden: these were his courtiers, each given a shard of his hollow crown and a den to rule.
lore.guildmark.3.page1: The lairs you clear are what is left of that court. Their masters still remember the crown, and some say they still answer when it calls.
lore.guildmark.4.title: Lore: The Sundering
lore.guildmark.4.page0: When the Wardens marched on the Hollow King, the battle split the land itself. The Old Guild won, but there were not enough Wardens left to keep the roads.
lore.guildmark.4.page1: Roads became grass. Villages forgot each other. Only the boards and the coins survived, and the coins were melted and stamped again as Guild Marks.
lore.guildmark.5.title: Lore: The Ledger of Names
lore.guildmark.5.page0: Every guild hall keeps a copy of the Ledger of Names: each adventurer who ever passed a trial, from F to S. The receptionists guard it closely.
lore.guildmark.5.page1: The oldest pages hold only Warden names, and the last of them is torn out. Receptionists will not say who tore it, or why.
lore.guildmark.6.title: Lore: The Seven Shards
lore.guildmark.6.page0: The Hollow King's crown did not melt. It broke into seven shards, and the shards were hidden where no one would look: in the dens of his own court.
lore.guildmark.6.page1: While the shards are apart, the King cannot wake. If they were ever brought together, he would rise wherever they met.
lore.guildmark.7.title: Lore: The Last Warden
lore.guildmark.7.page0: The last Warden was named Maren. She carried the torn page of the Ledger away from the final battle, and walked off the end of every map.
lore.guildmark.7.page1: Old travellers swear they have met her on the roads at dusk, asking each adventurer the same question: 'What rank are you, and is it enough?'

character.guildmark.wren.intro: Oh! You're the one with the guild contracts, aren't you? Wren Ashdown, cartographer. Well, I will be, once I finish a map anyone believes.
character.guildmark.wren.step0: I'm charting where the Old Guild hid things. Problem is, I've drawn so many maps I've run out of paper. Bring me twelve sheets and I'll tell you what I'm really after.
character.guildmark.wren.step1: Right, the secret: the Hollow King's crown broke into seven shards, and I think one is buried in a spider den near here. The spiders keep eating my survey stakes, though. Thin them out?
character.guildmark.wren.step1.note: "They ate my compass too. The whole compass."
character.guildmark.wren.step2: Found the den. It goes deep, and something big lives at the bottom. You go first. I'll take notes. Very brave notes.
character.guildmark.wren.step2.note: "If you find a shiny bit of crown, do not lick it."
character.guildmark.wren.waiting: Still at it? Take your time. Actually, don't. I'm terribly impatient.
character.guildmark.wren.finale: You found it! A real shard of the crown. Seven of these together and the Hollow King wakes, so let's never put them together, yes? Keep it. You'll mind it better than I would.
character.guildmark.wren.done: Six shards left out there. I'm marking every rumour on my map. When you're ready, the world will be waiting.
character.guildmark.wren.gift: First Shard of the Hollow Crown
character.guildmark.wren.gift.lore: Cold to the touch. It hums near lairs.
character.guildmark.tobin.epithet: The Old Sword, last squire of the Wardens
character.guildmark.tobin.intro: Hmph. Another badge-polisher. Name's Tobin. I carried a Warden's shield before your grandmother was born, and I've watched every guild since go soft.
character.guildmark.tobin.step0: Prove you're not soft. The dead are walking the old charter road again. Put down a dozen of them and we'll talk.
character.guildmark.tobin.step0.note: "Aim for the head. They don't need it, but it slows them down."
character.guildmark.tobin.step1: Not bad. I mean to forge a Warden's blade one last time, but my forge is cold and my stock is empty. Sixteen iron ingots. Good ones.
character.guildmark.tobin.step1.note: "Not the rusty stuff from shipwrecks. I'll know."
character.guildmark.tobin.step2: The blade's ready, but it needs a purpose. There's a barrow where my old master was laid to rest, and something wearing his armour rules it now. Lay him to rest properly.
character.guildmark.tobin.step2.note: "Tell him Tobin sent you. He won't listen. Hit him anyway."
character.guildmark.tobin.waiting: Standing around won't get it done. Off with you.
character.guildmark.tobin.finale: So it's done. He can rest. Here, a Warden's blade is no use hanging on my wall. The oath goes: 'The road is the only home we keep.' Don't make me regret it.
character.guildmark.tobin.done: The road is long, adventurer. Keep it clear.
character.guildmark.tobin.gift.lore: "The road is the only home we keep."
character.guildmark.ilsa.epithet: Cleric of the Quiet Bell, scholar of the Hollow King
character.guildmark.ilsa.intro: Ah, forgive me, I didn't hear you come in. I'm Ilsa. I study the things most clerics pray never to hear of. Chiefly, the Hollow King.
character.guildmark.ilsa.step0: The skeletons around here have started humming, all on the same note. Bring down ten of them and I'll listen to what's left.
character.guildmark.ilsa.step0.note: "Please don't step on the skulls. I need those."
character.guildmark.ilsa.step1: It's a summons. Something is calling the old court back together. Amethyst holds a sound for a long time, so with eight shards I can catch the echo and learn where it comes from.
character.guildmark.ilsa.step1.note: "Clear ones, if you can. Cloudy amethyst only remembers rumours."
character.guildmark.ilsa.step2: The echo leads to a hollow where a crone keeps the King's old rites. She was one of his courtiers. If she falls, the call goes quiet. For now.
character.guildmark.ilsa.step2.note: "Do not answer if she speaks your name."
character.guildmark.ilsa.waiting: The bones are still humming. Please hurry, if you can.
character.guildmark.ilsa.finale: The humming has stopped. Thank you. I've copied out what I learned about the King and his court, and you should have it. And take this. I'd feel better knowing you carry it.
character.guildmark.ilsa.done: The court is quiet, but quiet is not gone. I'll keep listening.
character.guildmark.ilsa.gift.lore: A totem wrapped in a cleric's prayer ribbon.

character.guildmark.maren.scene0.p0: Don't reach for your sword. I'm not one of his.
character.guildmark.maren.scene0.p1: My name is Maren. The old ledgers call me the Last Warden. I tore the last page out of the Ledger of Names so the King could never read the names of those who broke him, and that page has kept me here ever since. Not alive. Not gone.
character.guildmark.maren.scene0.p2: You carry three shards of his crown. Every one you take weakens his court, but it wakes him a little more too. The shards can only be broken where he was crowned: the Hollow Throne.
character.guildmark.maren.scene0.p3: Find all seven. When you have them, I'll be waiting at the throne, and we'll finish what my Wardens started.
character.guildmark.maren.scene1.p0: You came. All seven. I can feel them from here.
character.guildmark.maren.scene1.p1: When you set them on the Shattering Stone, he'll rise to take them back. He'll call his knights and the echoes of every courtier you've killed, and when the crown starts to burn, so will the sky.
character.guildmark.maren.scene1.p2: I can't hold a sword anymore, but I can still draw a bow. Stand your ground and break his crown.
character.guildmark.maren.scene2.p0: It's done. The crown is dust, and the page is finally quiet.
character.guildmark.maren.scene2.p1: Your name is written on it now, under mine. Keep the roads, Warden. The road is the only home we keep.
main.guildmark.start: Wait, before you go! Take my compass. I fixed it so it points at the next shard instead of north. Six more are out there, each guarded by one of the King's old court. Find them before somebody worse does.
main.guildmark.new_compass: Lost it already? Here's another. I make them in batches for exactly this reason.
main.guildmark.letter1: Two shards! The Broodmother had it in her nest the whole time. My map says the next one lies in a barrow. Tobin went very quiet when I told him.
main.guildmark.letter2: So the court took my old master's tomb and dressed one of its own in his armour. You've laid him to rest twice over now. Thank you. And watch yourself: something followed you out of that barrow, and it wasn't a monster.
main.guildmark.letter3: The Herald was the court's voice. It sang the King's summons across the water, and now the bones near my chapel have finally stopped humming. Four shards. Be careful, they've started humming instead.
main.guildmark.letter4: The Crone kept the King's rites. Her echo was preparing a coronation. His. Five shards now. Whatever you do, don't put them together until Maren says so.
main.guildmark.letter5: The Frost Regent was a Warden once, the only one who knelt to the King. I've spat on his name for fifty years, and now you've ended him. Six. One left.
main.guildmark.letter6: SEVEN! That's all of them! My compass has gone mad, it's pointing somewhere I've never mapped. Maren's throne. Ilsa says go. Tobin says go armed. I say bring me back a sketch.
main.guildmark.throne_begin: Here he comes. Stay out of reach when he raises that sword!
main.guildmark.finale: It's over. Your name is on the last page now, under mine. Keep the roads, Warden.
main.guildmark.epilogue.wren: Ilsa felt it all the way from her chapel, and Tobin cried. Don't tell him I told you. Come visit! I want to draw the throne.
main.guildmark.epilogue.tobin: A Warden again, after all these years. My forge is yours whenever you need it, Warden.
main.guildmark.epilogue.ilsa: The bones are silent everywhere. For the first time in my life I can't hear the court at all. Thank you.
lore.guildmark.8.title: Lore: The Broodmother
lore.guildmark.8.page0: The Broodmother was the first beast to bow. The King gave her the darkest caves and a shard to guard, and she wrapped it in silk so thick that light itself got lost.
lore.guildmark.8.page1: Her brood still spins webs shaped like crowns. Cartographers who map them tend to stop making maps.
lore.guildmark.9.title: Lore: The Barrow Lord
lore.guildmark.9.page0: The Barrow Lord has no body of his own. He wears the armour of the dead, and he is always looking for better armour.
lore.guildmark.9.page1: He took a Warden's barrow for his seat and a Warden's plate for his skin. A squire named Tobin swore to put him in the ground. It took fifty years to find someone who could.
lore.guildmark.10.title: Lore: The Drowned Herald
lore.guildmark.10.page0: Every court needs a voice. The Herald sang the King's commands across rivers and seas, and anything drowned that heard it rose to obey.
lore.guildmark.10.page1: Fishermen still hear its song on still nights. The wise ones row home and don't look back.
lore.guildmark.11.title: Lore: The Hollow Crone
lore.guildmark.11.page0: The Crone keeps the King's rites: what must be burned, what must be buried, and what must be spoken at a coronation.
lore.guildmark.11.page1: Her book of rites ends with one unfinished line: 'And when the seven are one, the crown shall'
lore.guildmark.12.title: Lore: The Frost Regent
lore.guildmark.12.page0: The Frost Regent was a Warden once. When the others marched on the throne he knelt to it, and the King gave him a shard and a heart of ice to keep it cold.
lore.guildmark.12.page1: The Wardens struck his name from the Ledger. It is the only name ever struck out.
lore.guildmark.13.title: Lore: The Ash Warden
lore.guildmark.13.page0: The Ash Warden guards the deepest pit and the last shard. It was the King's champion, and it has never lost a duel.
lore.guildmark.13.page1: It burned the roads the Wardens built. Now, at last, someone is walking back along them.
lore.guildmark.last_page.title: The Last Page of the Ledger
lore.guildmark.last_page.page0: The torn last page of the Ledger of Names. The oldest names on it are Wardens: Aldric, Senna, Brannoch, Ivo, and at the very bottom, Maren.
lore.guildmark.last_page.page1: Below Maren's name, in ink that is still wet, a new name has been written: %s, Warden of the Road.
lore.guildmark.last_page.page2: The oath, in Maren's hand: 'We keep no crown and no village. We keep the roads between them, so no stranger walks alone. The road is the only home we keep.'
relic.guildmark.legendary.oathkeeper.lor: Sworn on it once. Never broken since.
relic.guildmark.legendary.dawnbreaker.lo: Carried out of the Long Night by the last Warden standing.
relic.guildmark.legendary.ledgerbane.lor: Every debt it settles is written in red.
relic.guildmark.legendary.marens_promise: "Someone has to finish what we started."
Rung for every village that held.
Forged from the throne's own iron, to undo it.
relic.guildmark.legendary.aegis_of_aldri: The first Guildmaster never once took it off.
relic.guildmark.legendary.sennas_grace.l: She walked through the Hollow Court and out again.
relic.guildmark.legendary.brannochs_bulw: Dented by a hundred sieges. Pierced by none.
relic.guildmark.legendary.ivos_stride.lo: He ran every road before there were roads.
